name: ilana
description: Ìlànà — software engineering process operating system. Load when work touches requirements, SRS, design, coding standards, testing (unit/integration/system/acceptance), SCM, quality assurance, CMMI, ISO/IEC 12207, Git branching, release management, CI/CD, defect tracking, ethics, or team dynamics. Also load when the user says 'ilana', 'run the process', 'ship this properly', 'gate this', 'audit this repo', or asks for a disciplined end-to-end engineering workflow.
origin: SEN102/212 Software Engineering Process, Obafemi Awolowo University, a sample city

command.description: boot: start or resume Ìlànà. status: show current phase/gate/open items. gate: run the checklist for a specific gate. override: force a gate open with a recorded reason. resume: explicitly continue from last recorded state.

gate.description: Gate to check or override. Required for command=gate and command=override.

phase.description: Override the current phase. Use when resuming at a specific point.

mode.description: FLEET: full gated lifecycle with all 13 specialist agents. TASK: one specialist, one artifact. AUDIT: score an existing codebase. TUTOR: learn the process. DOCTOR: diagnose a broken process. DRILL: self-assessment quiz.

rigour.description: 1=advisory (script/spike), 2=warn (internal tool), 3=enforce (production SaaS), 4=regulated (finance/health), 5=safety-critical (no overrides). Set during intake; changes gate bite.

agent.description: Specialist agent to speak as for TASK mode.

reason.description: Required when command=override. The user's stated reason for forcing a gate open. Recorded permanently in the ledger.
